title: ENTER IN THE BACKPACK LEAVES THE CARD
why: Found by the review of 2026-10-08, in v19.28: the what is new card waits behind the open floor backpack, but ENTER (equip from the backpack) still dismissed it there, so a returning player who opened the bag first lost the card unseen for the rest of the load. ENTER only dismisses the card when the bag is closed.
now: Pressing ENTER in the Undercroft backpack no longer throws away the what is new card.
